name: scroll-animation-default
title: Scroll Reveal Images
description: A full-width gallery of horse and landscape pictures laid out in three masonry columns. Each photo starts faint and off position, then fades into place once about half of it is on screen.
use: A photo-led page wants its pictures to appear gradually as visitors scroll instead of all at once.
avoid: The ten photo slots are fixed Unsplash links and repeat the same few pictures, so the wall looks thin.
a11y: Every photo has an empty alt, so the wall carries no descriptions, and reduced-motion is never checked. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black page with a centred white Scroll Down heading and a downward hand emoji. Below it, photos stack in three narrow columns with small gaps, lit by bright skies and green fields against the dark ground.
behaves: Scrolling brings each photo in on its own: it appears faint and slightly displaced, sharpens as it enters the middle of the viewport, and then stays put. Earlier rows remain and the wall fills from the top down.
customise: No props: the heading and the ten image links are written in the file, and the reveal threshold sits in the viewport options given to each photo.
weight: moderate: Ten remote photos load at once and each keeps a viewport observer.
demo: Horse portraits in fields and on moorland plus a red-and-white striped awning, under a Scroll Down prompt.
issues: The same few photos repeat down the wall, so nine slots show only a handful of images.
Three columns stay on phones, so pictures shrink to narrow slivers.
Frame 1 is almost empty, with one clipped photo at the bottom edge.
polishWhy: Calm fade and a clean masonry wall; no captions, repeated photos and a bare heading.
